predecessor.frozen_finding: 23 of 36 price-blind observation classes have an empty common-optimum intersection
predecessor.why_a_successor: That is a qualitative boundary. #1649 asks how MUCH regret is forced and how much refinement buys.

quantity.name: regret floor
quantity.definition: R*(z) = min over actions a of max over environments e in the class of (cost_e(a) - opt_e)
quantity.computed_by: exhaustive enumeration over budget-feasible allocations, reusing the committed runner's own priced objective and charge computation

predictions.statement: The frozen allocator's worst-case regret on each class is >= R*(z). A measurement strictly below the floor refutes Q1.
Some action attains R*(z) on every class; the floor is achieved, not merely approached.

{z : R*(z) = 0} equals the 13 classes with nonempty common-optimum intersection and {z : R*(z) > 0} equals the 23 empty ones, reproducing the frozen result as a zero level set rather than assuming it.
Price refinement yields max over sub-classes of R* equal to 0, so the gain equals R*(z) exactly for every class.

controls.statement: A planted action known to be sub-floor must be caught by the SAME comparison used for P1. Without this, 'no violation' is indistinguishable from a comparison that cannot fire.

The zero set must be compared against the ALREADY-COMMITTED aliasing result, not merely against an internally recomputed intersection. A mismatch means this packet has re-modelled the object rather than quantifying it.
Every singleton class must have R* = 0, since O(e) is nonempty. A nonzero singleton floor is an analyzer defect.
The frozen pool hashes must resolve to files by CONTENT, not by guessed filename.

conditions: P3 agrees exactly with the frozen aliasing record
terminals.licenses: A bounded statement that on THIS frozen charging family the regret floor R*(z) is exact, the frozen qualitative boundary is its zero level set, and price refinement closes exactly R*(z).
does_not_license: transfer beyond the frozen charging family
any change to the aliasing terminal or the BINDING_NEGATIVE_BOUNDARY leaf

conditions: some measured worst-case regret is strictly below R*(z)
terminals.reading: Q1 is false, or the floor is being computed over the wrong action set.

conditions: the zero set of R* does not match the frozen aliasing record
terminals.reading: The quantitative and qualitative accounts disagree; one of them is wrong and neither may be reported until that is resolved.

conditions: Y1, Y2, Y3 or Y4 fails
